tha-ap346:1.1: Tīṇikiṅkhaṇikapūjaka.] Himavantass' avidūre Bhūtagaṇo nāma pabbato / tatth' addasaṃ paṃsukūlaṃ dumaggamhi vilaggitaṃ. // //
tha-ap346:2.1: Tīṇi kiṅkhaṇikapupphāni ocinitvān' ahan tadā / haṭṭho haṭṭhena cittena paṃsukūlam apūjayiṃ. // //
tha-ap346:3.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi tīṇipupphān' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap346:5.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Tīṇikiṅkhaṇikapūjako thero i. g. a-ti. Tīṇikiṅkhaṇikapūjakattherassa
